bg-000.$description: 3D viewport ground and 2D profile canvas. The deepest surface, so the rocket reads as the brightest object.

bg-100.$description: App window background, top bar, status strip.

bg-200.$description: Side panels: parts bin, inspector, Station Lanes.

bg-300.$description: Inputs, part tiles, raised rows inside a panel.

bg-400.$description: Hover on rows, tiles and buttons.

line-100.$description: Hairlines: panel frames, section rules, lane separators, minor grid. Decorative only, never a control's only boundary.

line-200.$description: Control borders and overlay frames (overlays have no shadow, just this 1px frame). 3:1 against bg-200.

ink.$description: Primary text and values on any bg.

ink-muted.$description: Field labels, secondary text, units suffixes.

ink-faint.$description: Section headers (uppercase), placeholders, disabled values. 4.5:1 on bg-300.

accent.$description: Shock orange. Selection brackets, primary buttons, focus, the active tab underline, live drag values. One meaning: 'this is what you are acting on'.

accent-ink.$description: Text and icons on an accent fill.

accent-soft.$description: Drop-zone and snap-target fill ONLY. Selection never uses a wash; it uses accent brackets and outlines.

cg.$description: Centre of gravity. Marker, readout and every CG plot line. Always blue, always the quartered-circle glyph.

cp.$description: Centre of pressure. Marker, readout and every CP plot line. Always red, always the dot-in-ring glyph; never used for errors.

ok.$description: Stable margin band, passing checks, valid attach node.

warn.$description: Warnings: marginal stability, diameter mismatch, fin flutter risk.

err.$description: Errors: unstable, invalid geometry, illegal drop. Pair with an icon; never confuse with cp, which is a quantity, not a state.

axis-z.$description: Gizmo / axis triad Z (along the rocket's axis, the one axis most handles move on).

grid-major.$description: Viewport major grid lines and the rocket axis centreline.

part-body.$description: Structure system colour, and the default airframe shading base in the viewport (nose, tubes, rings, bulkheads).

part-fin.$description: Default fin / flat-plate shading base in Solid view.

sys-aero.$description: Aero system: fins, canards, rail buttons, lugs. The edge of Aero bars in Station Lanes and Aero parts in X-ray / Cutaway.

sys-propulsion.$description: Propulsion system: motor mount, motor, engine block, thrust ring, retainer. Lanes edge + parts in Cutaway / X-ray.

sys-recovery.$description: Recovery system: chutes, drogue, shock cord, harness, charges. Lanes edge + parts in Cutaway / X-ray.

sys-avionics.$description: Avionics & payload system: altimeters, batteries, trackers, payload, ballast. Lanes edge + parts in Cutaway / X-ray.

lane-structure.$description: Station Lanes: Structure bar fill. Text on it is ink.

lane-avionics.$description: Station Lanes: Avionics & payload bar fill.

cut-face.$description: Hatching on cut faces in Cutaway view (airframe walls, rings, bulkheads where the section plane passes).

cut-interior.$description: The inside of the airframe exposed by Cutaway, behind the internals.

series-1.$description: Chart categorical slot 1 (aqua). Fixed order, never cycled. Validated with slots 2–4: CVD ΔE ≥ 8.4 dark / 9.1 light.

series-2.$description: Chart categorical slot 2 (yellow). Below 3:1 on light, so ship direct labels or a table.

series-4.$description: Chart categorical slot 4 (magenta). More than 4 series → fold into Other or use small multiples.

space-2.$description: Gap between fields in a row; tile padding.

space-3.$description: Panel inner padding; gap between inspector rows.

radius-0.$description: Everything: panels, buttons, inputs, overlays, tiles, chips, lane blocks.

radius-1.$description: Only to soften 1px anti-aliasing on tiny marks (badge, unit chip hover). Never visible as a curve.

control-h.$description: Height of inputs, buttons, segmented controls. Dense on purpose: the inspector must show a full fin set without scrolling.

rail-w.$description: Parts bin category rail width (icons only).

part-row-h.$description: Parts bin row: silhouette + name + default size.

lanes-h.$description: Station Lanes default height under the viewport: 24 px ruler, five lanes with one sub-row, 20 px balance footer (grows with sub-rows; collapsible to its ruler).

lane-h.$description: One lane in Station Lanes. A lane with overlapping parts adds 22 px sub-rows.

bracket.$description: Leg length of selection corner brackets, in the viewport and the Station Lanes.

ui-body.$description: Default UI text: labels, list rows, menus.

ui-section.$description: Uppercase mono panel section headers in ink-faint, prefixed with a two-digit index.

num-body.$description: Every editable value and every readout. Tabular, so digits don't shift while dragging.

num-readout.$description: Headline stability margin in the status strip and gauge.

num-label.$description: Viewport labels on CG/CP markers and dimension lines.
